snippet.title: Keycap Keycap! | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The free demo is out now! Play it and wishlist the full game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5082580/Keycap_Keycap/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer

Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap!

Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game. Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps.

#KeycapKeycap #IndieGame #IncrementalGame #solodev
